_readme: Copy this file to data/venue.json to personalize your own hub.
data/ is gitignored, so nothing you put here can ever be committed or pushed.
Every key is optional — omit anything you don't want to change.
Restart the server after editing (the file is read per request, but the
registry titles are resolved at import time).

brand._name: Wordmark in page titles, e.g. 'BINGO · SMITH FAMILY ARCADE'. Default: 'LAN GAMES'.
brand.name: SMITH FAMILY ARCADE
brand._presents: Big-screen splash kicker. Default: 'LAN GAMES PRESENTS'.
brand._titles: Per-game display-name overrides, keyed by registry slug.

_readme: Guest Wi-Fi for the hub's join-QR button. OMIT this whole block and the
button renders blank and offers these setup steps instead. Anyone on your
LAN who opens the hub can read this
password — that is the point (it's for guests), but don't put your admin
network here. Use your guest SSID.
wifi._hidden: true if the SSID is not broadcast — required or phones won't join from a scan.
